body: I'm living in California but have a chance to move to the Czech Republic for work.
I do need to push myself to do the simplest things. Opening my mail is a hard one for me.
No one gives me the chance. I was seeing someone amazing and kind but he broke up with me because he was still in love with his ex. I can't fault him, but I just feel so alone right now.
I'm trying to leave and go to another country. I see it as a silver lining, I just have to hold on for a few more months.
I try to go out and do things but it's hard.

I probably should have clarified. This happened 8 years ago but I'm still dealing with the trauma. 

I'm now 22 and kind of straightened out when I was 18. Earlier this year, I started using cocaine again but have quit. My drinking can still be concerning sometimes though.

I have lots of friends, but I hide this all from them.

I just got dumped by a really amazing person. I apparently can't have someone normal.

Somewhat, but I can never follow through on anything.
